name: lokal-skills
description: Lokal's shared Claude Code skills for org-wide, technology-agnostic coding standards.

plugins.name: basic-coding-standards
plugins.description: Audit a repository against baseline hygiene standards (README, CLAUDE.md coding standards + tech stack, CI coverage/branch correctness, secrets/.gitignore) and, for large codebases, flag structural debt and optionally draft a refactoring plan. Only applies changes after explicit confirmation.
